scope: B201, unchanged original R-CILQR time-parameterized trajectory, nominal initial pose, LTV-MPC tracking with dynamic obstacles at the original absolute time
purpose: Engineering acceptance targets fixed before evaluating final tracking, not universal safety guarantees or a literature standard.
reference_policy: Keep all original timestamps, poses, applied speed/rate inputs and the final timestamp. Interpolate pose in original time and hold inputs on their original intervals. Do not retime, reset reference progress from measured states or add a settling interval to scored data.
timing_policy: Report all controller computation times and deadline exceedances. A no-delay offline simulation is not evidence of real-time execution when computation exceeds the control period.
